comment: Hand-crafted from internal/issue/testdata/graphql/card_3.json (recorded): the cards the verbs of examples/review.toml read on the board of review_board.json for a dry run, one issue each, with their label, assignee, viewer and link lookups. #21 in Backlog, blocked by #20, closed: start assigns the viewer; #22 in progress: hold --by 17 adds blocked and links #17, open; #23 in progress with blocked, its blocker #18 merged and closed: resume removes the label; #24 in Changes requested: review swaps the labels and assigns octocat; #25 in review: request-changes swaps the labels; #26 in review: approve, the user's decision; #27 in review: reject closes it as not planned, the user's decision; #28 approved, still labelled blocked: merged moves it to Merged, removes the label and closes it.
